notes: THE PANE'S KICKER SITS OVER ITS TITLE AGAIN. "THE EDITOR" and "Where things live" had drifted to opposite ends of the pane: in the design they share one wrapper inside the head, so the head's space-between has nothing to push apart. Fixed…
THE FIRST TAB STARTS AT THE WINDOW'S EDGE. The design's navigation pulls itself out of the title bar's padding; ours sat 16px in.

⚠️ THE EDITOR REFLOWS WHEN IT GETS NARROW, which it did not. Below 860px the two columns stack and the divider turns from a vertical rule into a horizontal one — the design's own breakpoint. Below 620px the label column stops being a fixed…

TEXT NO LONGER SHIMMERS WHILE THE WINDOW IS DRAGGED. A transparent window has no opaque backing to blit, so every move re-rasterises the page — and a 56px blurred shadow makes that repaint expensive. The shadow comes off for the duration…

A governance gate was wrong and is fixed: the duplicate-selector check walked the stylesheet flat, so a rule inside a media query counted as a duplicate of the same selector outside it. A breakpoint is not a duplicate — it is the same…
